Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the title block.
The AB120 is an analogue acquisition module to acquire 8 low 
level measurements from
Thermo-electric couples
Sensors delivering signals of about 1 mV
It isolates and pre-processes the signals for CE2000.
The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Tawfeeq, tested by 
eng. Bahaa Abd El-Wahab, revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Adel El Nagga, accepted by 
general manager eng. Mohamed Elshreif, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawan head sector 
of Nubaria power station .
This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El Gillil 
MDEPC quality control general manager and MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. Mohammed Nageb 
quality control head sector.
Features
Dimension:
Height: 233 mm
Depth: 220 mm
Width: 1 slot = 25.4 mm
Weight: 
 0.400 kg
Operation
The AB120 module includes:
An analogue interface consisting of:
A switching converter
Eight low-level inputs (TC0 to TC7), each of which is fitted 
 with a filter network,
An RTD input to measure the temperature of cold junction,
A 0 V test channel and a full-scale test channel
An open line test channel,
A measuring chain (amplifier and voltage/frequency converter,
An opto-electronic interface,
An intelligent unit consisting of a micro-controller with the 
 following:
EPROM/RAM/EEPROM,
A clock with a maximum frequency of 16 MHZ
Three independent 16-bit counters,
An analogue interface control circuit,
An interface with the 2000 I/O backplane bus, consisting of:
A circuit for plugging in with power on,
A 2000 I/O bus slave interface,
The AB120 performs the measurement acquisition, in the course of 
which it:
Scans 
 the inputs cyclically
Detects 
 open lines (sensor disconnection)
Corrects 
 the offset or gain drift errors,
Linearizes 
 the measurements (thermocouples)
Compensates 
 for cold junction
Converts 
 the measurements into physical quantities (in C or mV) The AB120 module:
Tests 
 its own circuits
Converses with the higher level via the 2000 I/O bus
Handles 
 the conversation necessary for calibration and customization of the PCB
Controls and indications on the front panel
A green LED on the front panel indicates that the module is 
working. It goes out in the following cases:
The CE2000 rack PU does not have 
 access to the module
The module has detected a hardware 
 fault
The module has detected a user fault: loss of the process 
 voltage, disconnection of a channel.
PROTECTION
General protection on the process voltage +Vp by CTP with maximum 
tripping current at 20C: 0.45 A.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be 
 hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work place.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Work to be carried out
Check the supply voltage
Check the interface leds
